scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.check: pnpm types:worker && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm deploy:dry-run
scripts.db:list:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT id, content, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC"
scripts.db:list:remote: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command "SELECT id, content, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC"
